scope_note: Operational guidance alongside the pinned F01-F08 drafts. It does not change their bytes or their mandatory behaviour, is not part of what an adoption approval covers, and binds no role. Making any of it mandatory requires a new draft revision (new file, new digest) and its own independent adoption decision.

eligible_approvers.rule: decided only on /approvals/{id}/decide; the decider must not be the requester (server-enforced)

cross_sop_dependencies.F03_F06: F06 opens an initial ledger (S1-S2) from F01/F02 claims before F03 S5. F03 S5 rates themes provisionally against a named ledger version and appends its new claims as UNVERIFIED rows. F06 S7 updates the ledger as evidence arrives. F03 acceptance re-checks ratings against the ledger version current at decision time (F06 S8). Neither SOP waits for the other to finish.
cross_sop_dependencies.F07_inputs: F07 receives F06 unresolved critical evidence and open risks (F06 S8 output) with its F01-F05 positioning inputs.
cross_sop_dependencies.F08_inputs: F08 receives the selected F07 territory, its proof plan, open risks and F06 claim limitations.
